note: SPEC.md §7. `accent` names the content-accent token pair from SPEC.md §11 — six accents cover eight types, because pistol/revolver, rifle/carbine and submachine-gun/pdw each read as one visual family. It lives here so the mapping is data, not a switch statement in a component.

terms.label: Pistol
terms.description: A handgun whose chamber is integral to the barrel.

terms.label: Revolver
terms.description: A handgun feeding from a rotating cylinder of chambers.

terms.label: Rifle
terms.description: A shoulder-fired arm with a rifled barrel, full-length by the standards of its own pattern.

terms.label: Carbine
terms.description: A shortened rifle, usually of a pattern that also exists at full length.

terms.label: Shotgun
terms.description: A shoulder-fired arm firing a shot charge or slug, exempt from the 20 mm bore rule (SPEC.md §15).

terms.label: Submachine gun
terms.description: A select-fire or automatic arm firing a pistol cartridge.

terms.label: Machine gun
terms.description: An automatic arm firing a rifle or heavier cartridge, fed for sustained fire.

terms.label: Personal defence weapon
terms.description: A compact automatic arm firing a purpose-designed intermediate cartridge.
